youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the one deciding whether to keep going.

He: Jesus... the shop hasn't made a profit in a year. 🏪
He: Everyone says shut it down. I can't tell hope from stubbornness anymore.
Jesus: Stubbornness leans on your own plan. Hope leans on Me. They don't feel alike.
He: But hope doesn't pay rent. I'm scared to go on and scared to stop.
Jesus: I fill you with joy and peace while you trust Me. The full heart comes first.
Jesus: Abounding hope isn't a full till. It's a full heart while the till fills.
What would you keep going for on hope alone?

“Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.”
Romans 15:13 (KJV)
